<reason>Side A (CON) won by narrowing the clash to survivor-centered tradeoff. B's moral continuity and taxpayer-fairness case was strong, but A neutralized enforceability with the courtroom/binding-indemnity reply, exposed that no archives no discharge equals finality for curated disclosure with uncertifiable completeness, and turned B's state-seed concession into identical survivor compensation with only treasury reimbursement gained for permanent closure lost.
